# Authority record for api-design

## Scholarly citation

- OpenAPI Specification 3.1.0. https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.0 (accessed 2026-07-21). Apache-2.0. Vendored snapshot: `assets/authority/reference-source/openapi-specification/OpenAPI-Specification-3.1.0.md`.
- RFC 7807: Problem Details for HTTP APIs. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807 (accessed 2026-07-21). IETF Trust.
- Fielding, Roy Thomas. Architectural Styles and the Design of Network-based Software Architectures (PhD thesis, 2000). https://www.ics.uci.edu/~fielding/pubs/dissertation/ (accessed 2026-07-21).

## Derivation boundary

- Derived from vendored source: OpenAPI Object, Paths, Components, Security Schemes, and data types from the OpenAPI Specification 3.1.0.
- First-party synthesis: resource naming conventions, versioning policy, error-response patterns, and operational guidance for contract review.
- Outside scope: framework-specific implementation, code-generation tooling details, and non-HTTP API styles.

## Attribution

- OpenAPI Specification used under the Apache-2.0 license.
- RFC 7807 and Fielding dissertation citations are retained for design provenance and are not vendored in this repository.
